# Göktigin

> Göktigin is a software studio in Antalya Teknokent, Turkey. We build and run our own products: Art of Menu for restaurants and Chaput, a social app for iOS and Android.

Legal name: Göktigin Bilişim Teknoloji Ltd. Şti.
Location: Antalya Teknokent, Antalya, Turkey
Contact: hello@goktigin.com
Last updated: 2026-11-20

## Products

- [Art of Menu](https://artofmenu.com): Guests scan the QR code on the table to see the menu, order and call a waiter. Owners run menus, prices, branches, tables and staff from one web panel, and prices can change with the hour and the weather on their own.
- [Chaput](https://chaput.app): A social app for the goth community where women come first. It is not a dating app. Every profile is a tree, people tie chaputs to each other's trees, and men join once three women in the community approve them. Available on iOS and Android.
- Benek: An app that connects pet owners with sitters they can trust. It is on hold while we put our time into Art of Menu and Chaput.

## FAQ

### What is Göktigin?

Göktigin Bilişim Teknoloji Ltd. Şti. is a software studio at Antalya Teknokent, Turkey. We make our own products: Art of Menu, a QR menu and table ordering system for restaurants, and Chaput, a social app for iOS and Android.

### What is Art of Menu?

Restaurant software made by Göktigin. Guests scan the QR code on the table to see the menu, order and call a waiter; owners manage menus, prices, branches, tables and staff from a web panel. More at artofmenu.com.

### What is Chaput?

A social app for the goth community where women come first, made by Göktigin for iOS and Android. It is not a dating app: every profile is a tree others can tie a chaput to, and men join after three women approve them. More at chaput.app.

### Where is Göktigin based?

At Antalya Teknokent, the technology park in Antalya, Turkey.

### How do I contact Göktigin?

Write to hello@goktigin.com. We reply by email.
